title: FSSAI Tuber Size & Solid Content Criteria
details: Table potatoes must exhibit dry matter content >= 18% and tuber diameter between 45mm and 80mm for optimal industrial processing and retail sale.

title: Defect Tolerance Thresholds
details: Grade A permits maximum 3% aggregate superficial defects. Grade B permits up to 10% minor scab or scuffing with 0% decay or late blight rot.
